p: Will take first-team practice reps this week and is positioned to start if Herbert can't play.
If Herbert is out, Uiagalelei is the likely starter, which matters for the whole Chargers passing game.
I've seen a lot of growth from DJ.
Uiagalelei would start if Herbert cannot play, with Jake Browning also brought up.
He is a streaming QB option only if Herbert is ruled out.
He would be, he would be the next man up.
